title: Simulated canary for adaptive batch/cache policy grading
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a simulation-driven canary framework that evaluates candidate per-route and per-customer batching/caching policies against historic traffic. The framework will grade each policy by cost delta, latency regression, and output-quality drift, and provide an automated, staged apply/rollback plan with human-in-the-loop gates.
background: We currently rely on dry-run telemetry and manual review to validate batching/cache policies before applying to production. This is slow and brittle for fine-grained (per-customer, per-route) policies. Earlier attempts focused only on token-cost metrics and missed regressions in tail latency and output quality for low-volume routes.
goals: Produce a reproducible simulation that replays a configurable window of real traffic with candidate policy applied
Generate a graded report (cost, latency, success-rate, quality delta) per route and per tenant
Create a staged canary apply that maps simulation grades to rollout thresholds and automated rollback triggers
Expose a compact operator runbook with remediation steps and links to artifacts
success_metrics: Reduction in mean per-token cost for targeted segments >= 8% without exceeding latency SLOs
False-positive rollback rate < 2% during first 30 days of rollout
Time from policy authoring to safe rollout < 48 hours (including simulation)
acceptance_criteria: Simulator can replay 7 days of production traffic with >99% request fidelity for routing, sequence length distribution, and input sizes
Policy grader produces per-route CSV with columns: route, tenant, cost_delta_pct, p50_delta_ms, p95_delta_ms, q_score_delta, failure_rate_delta
Staged apply supports dry-run -> 1% tenant canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automated immediate rollback on any grade drop > threshold
Operator UI showback for each canary with link to graded report and anchors for PR/Confluence design doc
rollout_plan: 1) Integrate simulator into sandbox environment and replay last 7 days of traffic for a selected pilot (3 tenants across low/med/high volume). 2) Run policy grader and produce candidate mappings from grade -> allowed rollout fraction. 3) Run a shadow canary in staging for 48 hours (metrics only). 4) Execute staged apply in production: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%, each stage 24h with automated rollback triggers. 5) Post-mortem and metric confirmation after final stage.
simulation_details: Simulator replays request arrivals preserving timestamps and sequence lengths. Key-value cache effects are approximated via per-route prefix hit models derived from historical KV cache logs. Batching behavior is simulated using the same batching windowing logic as runtime with configurable max batch sizes. Output-quality is scored using existing prompt-based eval heuristics and a lightweight semantic similarity check (embedding cosine + heuristics).
simulation_results_summary: Pilot run (3 tenants, 7-day replay) produced mixed results: cost_delta_avg = -11.2% across medium+high volume tenants; p95 latency increased by 12% on one low-volume route due to batching edge cases; quality drift within noise for 2 tenants but one edge-case route showed a quality drop of -4.8 points on our rubric. See attachments for full CSV and visualizations.
recommended_tuning_actions: Exclude routing key 'rpc/legacy-formatter' from batching (allowlist removal) because it increases p95
Lower max_batch_size from 64 to 32 for routes with median sequence length > 1k
Enable prefix-KV lightweight cache for top-10 high-frequency tenants to amplify savings without changing batching windows
Add a trial A/B variant for the problematic tenant with conservative batching + disabled async-prefetch for 72 hours
safety_guards: Automatic rollback if any of: p95 latency increase > 15% for the canary segment, failed_calls_rate increase > 0.5 percentage points, output_quality_score_delta < -3.0 for two successive evaluation windows. Manual abort if simulation-grade disagrees with shadow staging by > 2 grade tiers.
deployment_commands_examples:
1) simulator run: ./tools/policy-sim --policy-file=policies/tenant_A_v2.json --start=2025-02-01 --end=2025-02-08 --output=reports/tenantA-run.csv
2) apply canary: infra/rollout apply --policy policies/tenant_A_v2.json --target-tenants=selector('canary_group') --fraction=0.01 --guard-file=guards/tenantA.json
